title: User-managed service account key is old
detail: A user-managed service account key is older than 90 days. User-managed keys are long-lived downloadable private keys and are the highest-risk GCP credential; they should be rotated regularly or replaced with keyless authentication. The 90-day threshold lives in this signed rule; the key age in days is a collected fact. A key whose age is undeterminable is reported not assessed, never passed.
